name: Lookup Search
tagline: A lookup column as a type-ahead search over the target table.

limitations: Typing searches nothing. The control calls webAPI.retrieveMultipleRecords() against the table the lookup points at, and there is no environment behind this origin to answer — so the demo shows the control's own "search unavailable" state rather than an empty result list, which is what a real form would never show.

The target table is read from the preset rather than from the column. On a form, context.parameters.value.getTargetEntityType() names the table the lookup points at; the harness builds a property bag with no methods on it, so the control falls back to the entityType carried by the value it was given. A preset with no value therefore has no target at all, and says so.

Search columns cannot be demonstrated. The primary name column comes from utils.getEntityMetadata(), which is model-driven only and absent here, so neither matchMode nor searchColumns changes anything you can see.
Browse opens nothing. utils.lookupObjects() is the platform's own lookup panel; outside a model-driven app there is no panel to open, and the button reports the failure instead of showing one.

Filtering by a parent (Filter by, 0.2.0) cannot be shown. It reads the searched table's relationships from the organisation through context.page, which this harness does not have, so a preset with a parent mapped would only show the control's "could not be read" state. No preset maps one; every preset here behaves as a form with no parent configured.

What does work is everything that never leaves the browser: the selected record renders, Clear empties it and reports the new value, and the disabled, hidden, no-access and business-rule-error states are all reachable from the presets.

presets.name: A record selected
presets.description: The state a form is usually in — a lookup that already points somewhere. Clear empties it.

presets.name: Nothing selected
presets.description: An empty lookup. With no value and no form behind it there is no target table either, which is the message the control shows.

presets.name: Search only
presets.description: The same control with the Browse button switched off, for forms that want one way in rather than two.
